figurative_meaning_en: To cast an evil eye or envious gaze
example_sentences_in_bangla: সেই নতুন গাড়ির উপর তার প্রতিবেশী নজর দিয়েছে।
বাচ্চাটির সুন্দর মুখের দিকে দেখন্তি নজর দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: His neighbor cast an envious eye on the new car.
The aunt gave an evil eye to the child's beautiful face.
history: The idiom derives from the widespread belief in the 'evil eye' (nazar) influenced by Arabic and Islamic traditions in Bengali culture, where an envious glance is thought to bring misfortune.
note: Often used to ward off bad luck with protective charms like black dots or taweez in Bengali households.
